issues.suggestedFix: Not a defect of the localization. Raise the registry duration to 140 (a library-level change outside this card) so future reviews have original frames to compare.

issues.where: Content bars (right-anchored) vs the symmetric outline
issues.problem: Right-anchoring is a legitimate RTL decision. It is a judgement call because the bars are abstract and the card has no text, so the weight shift is subtle.

notes: Rendered frames 0,15,20,36,42,48,54,60,66,139 with --duration 140. The circle at frame 15 and frame 0 are pixel-identical in layout to the original (same radius, center, stroke, background). The mid-morph barrel contour at frame 48 matches the source prompt's description, with no self-intersection or spikes. At frame 139 the card outline is centered and unclipped. The header bar and two body bars are right-anchored at the same start edge with the original 58%/86%/72% widths. The footer avatar sits on the right with the short bar to its left, consistent with the RTL decisions in the header comment. Diffed against the original: the path math, constants, easing and frame cues (10/20/30, 30-54, 56-68) are identical. The only changes are the FaRoot wrapper (direction rtl, Vazirmatn) and the import. There is no text, so no shaping, letter-spacing, ZWNJ, digit or foreign-text concerns. There is no raster. The geometry correctly stays unmirrored since the circle and outline are symmetric. Grep hits for left/top are the absolute card box, which is centered (CX - RECT_W/2) and so needs no mirroring. Nothing blocks shipping.
